The Qur'an mentions roses and other flowers as abundant blessings from Allah. The name Zoona, reflecting the blossom of a beautiful flower, can serve as a reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and an inspiration to nurture one's faith throughout life. It's a name that carries a profound symbolism for both the worldly and spiritual aspects of life.
